text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about how it affects people. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from the data they are given. This can lead to decisions that are not fair, especially in areas like hiring or banking. Privacy is another key issue, since AI often collects and uses personal information. Transparency matters too, because people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must work together to create rules that protect everyone and build trust in this powerful technology.
